scores.rationale: The detached HEAD matches the requested SHA; the frozen contract and candidate fingerprints reproduce exactly from the commit tree. The contract pins the canonical baseline, accounts for donors A-N with accepted and rejected boundaries, and Git history contains no wholesale merge commit in the evaluated range.

Canonical records remain the authority registry for Wiki references, and the source-return evaluator requires every approved page and receipt authority to resolve to that registry. All ten pages and the receipt retain existing canonical authorities; exact-set, orphan, unsupported-reference, citation, and lifecycle mutations are represented in the validation suites.

The agency relation layer classifies the proof bank as an exact set and carries bounded action, shared-credit scope, support, confidence, and anti-claims. Mutation checks explicitly reject sole causality, title inflation, collaborator erasure, unknown support, and endorsement drift; representative Wiki pages preserve collective attribution while keeping Jamie's supported actions visible.

The operator surfaces wrap the canonical lifecycle, distinguish validation and query operations from publication, and include non-promotion and leak controls. Their source and tests are review-ready, although the full dependency-backed command suite could not be rerun in this dependency-free checkout.

Survivorship states remain bounded, protected scans stay outside public projection, and factual support is explicitly separated from quotation, artifact, image, consent, and display permission. The source-return receipt avoids converting non-recovery into nonexistence and routes discoveries back through source, claim, inquiry, correction, and projection review.

The composition manifest keeps route-specific audience, argument, action, selection, budgets, and omissions separate from the bank. The candidate-bound mosaic review identifies reconstructive combinations and continuing holds, while the Wiki pages remain internal public-safe projections rather than new public routes or a raw bank dump.

This independent read-only receipt reproduces the frozen contract and exact candidate bindings, uses the required schema, and reports no optimizer self-grade or unseen aggregate conclusion. Per the contract, an individual receipt cannot derive aggregate score 4.

Source inspection shows ordered graph, privacy, composition, route, release-policy, and human-gate checks, with staging noindex and production indexing explicitly approval-gated. Full build, browser, and runtime layers were not rerun because dependencies are absent and installation was prohibited; this is an environment limitation rather than an instrument defect.

Human reader review, hands-on launch QA, rights, consent, collaborator review, exact-candidate production approval, and indexing remain visibly reserved to people. The source-return evaluation keeps librarian review not requested and states that a passing machine score cannot change it.
